WHAT IF DEBT WAS A FEELING?

The taiyaki shop has custard now
The old tunnel is still closed
suzunari_review: Five stars. The stars were extra.
My dog likes it. My dog is a crow.
suzunari_reply: Shh! The billboard can hear you.
You can't say that out loud.
I'd laugh, but laughing costs extra.
I heard the #team# are getting sold for parts.
the TV news said it's fine, so it's fine.
We should start a union. Kidding. Unless?
Keep your voice down, the police's on #street#.
Sure, sure. And I'm a shareholder.
suzunari_food_scene: Steam rolls off a wok the size of a satellite dish.
Rain drums on the awning. Inside it's warm and loud and smells of garlic.
Three regulars hunch over their bowls without looking up. A good sign. Or a hostage situation.
The menu board flickers between #dish# and something with no name.
A cat sleeps on the counter. There's a cat on the menu board too. Different cat, hopefully.
suzunari_food_keeper: The cook doesn't look up. "#dish#? Or #dish#? Those are the choices."
"Sit, sit! Today's special is #dish#. Yesterday's special was also #dish#."
"Cash, money or a good story. Mostly money."
The owner taps a sign: NO NOODLES-SHAMING. "What'll it be?"
"You look hungry. Everyone looks hungry. Sit down."
"Kitchen closes when the rain stops. The rain never stops."
suzunari_bar_scene: A lantern sign buzzes 'OPEN' with the P burned out.
Somebody in the corner is losing an argument with a jukebox.
Two dockers arm-wrestle under a dead billboard of a cocktail.
A screen over the bar plays #media_product# on mute. Nobody watches.
suzunari_bar_keeper: "What'll it be? And don't say water. Water's extra."
"First drink's full price. Second drink's full price. I don't do discounts."
"If you're with #faction#, you pay double. If you're not, you pay regular double."
The bartender polishes a glass that will never be clean. "Talk or drink. Or both."
suzunari_arcade_scene: Cabinets from four centuries blink in the dark, all of them playing to nobody.
A kid with no shoes holds the top score on every machine.
The carpet has seen things. Glowing, beeping things.
suzunari_arcade_keeper: "Tokens! Five for #small_num# money! Or one for a face scan!"
The attendant points at a cabinet called #cabinet#. "New one. Nobody's beaten level 2."
"No crying on the machines. They short out."
suzunari_clinic_keeper: The medic looks at you, then at your wallet. "Where does it hurt? Be specific, it's itemised."
"No insurance? Good. Insurance just makes it slower."
"I can fix most things. I can't fix the price."
A nurse-crow chirps: "WELCOME. YOUR WAIT TIME IS #small_num# HOURS. OR #small_num# YEN."
suzunari_motel_keeper: The clerk doesn't look up from #media_product#. "Pod or premium pod? Premium has a window. It's painted on."
"Dreams are recorded for quality purposes. Opting out is #small_num# money."
suzunari_loans_scene: A smiling billboard greets you by your money score.
Gold carpet, white leather and no windows at all.
A brochure shows a happy family. The small print says they belong to the bank.
Every chair faces a screen counting up somebody's interest.
suzunari_loans_keeper: "Debt is just a future you haven't paid for yet!"
The broker's smile doesn't move. "Let's talk about your potential."
suzunari_tattoo_scene: Needles buzz like angry bees. Flash sheets cover every wall.
Lantern light, antiseptic and an old enka record crackling.
suzunari_tattoo_keeper: "What'll it be? No company logos. Unless you're paying company prices."
suzunari_air_scene: Canisters stacked like ammunition, every one labelled MOUNTAIN FRESH.
The kiosk hisses. It might be a leak. It might be the ambience.
suzunari_air_keeper: The vendor taps a canister. "Smell that? That's freedom. #small_num# money."
suzunari_implants_scene: Sparks rain off a workbench where someone is getting a new knee.
The diagnostics screen flickers: WARRANTY VOID.
A poster of a smiling mascot: NEW YEAR, NEW YOU.
suzunari_fortune_scene: Incense, a cracked crystal ball and a card reader.
Beaded curtains and a cat with one eye. The eye is a camera.
suzunari_fortune_keeper: "I see... debt. No, wait. That's everyone."
"Cross my palm with money and I'll cross yours with destiny."
suzunari_corp_store_scene: Bright, clean, scentless. Music designed to make you forget you have a home.
Every shelf faces you. Every product smiles.
A greeter-crow sings the store's name in four-part harmony.
The aisles are arranged so the exit is always one more aisle away.
suzunari_station: the bus stop by the river
suzunari_radio_tag: Stay tuned. Literally: changing stations is a billable event.
The only station that doesn't track you. (It does.)
Don't touch that dial. It's leased.
suzunari_traffic: sky-lane 4 is jammed by a debt convoy
smooth, if you can afford the toll
a billboard fell over on the main drag - mind the dancing
suzunari_death_title: THE BELL RINGS A THIRD TIME
suzunari_death_line: Something with two tails drags you down to the dry riverbed. Then nothing, for a while.
Your umbrella rolls away across the stones. The festival music goes on without you.
Cold hands, a smell of incense, and someone crying your name from very far away.
The kasha carry you off the way they carry off the dead. Somebody on the other side of the steps won't let go of you.
suzunari_close_poor: Don't tell my landlord I talked.
I've got a queue to stand in.
suzunari_close_rebel: Remember: they need us more than we need them.
suzunari_close_weird: Don't eat the blue instant noodles.
I've said too much. Or not enough.
Tell the walls I said hello.
That's what the static told me.
suzunari_pc_class_heir_paragon: Your family's cops arrested my cousin for coughing. Nothing personal.
A the police heir walking without bodyguards? Bold.
Does daddy know you're slumming it in Suzunari?
Every badge on this street answers to your family. Must be nice.
They say police heirs learn to salute before they learn to walk.
Your family's slogan is on every baton in Suzunari.
Somebody said a police heir walked in. I assumed it was a raid.
suzunari_pc_class_heir_halcyon: the bank owns the debt on my bed. So, technically, you're standing on my mattress.
A the bank heir. My whole family's in your ledger.
Interest compounds, they say. So does resentment.
Do you get a discount on your own debt? Asking for Suzunari.
My whole street owes your surname money.
the bank heir in Suzunari? Collecting in person now?
suzunari_pc_class_heir_gristle: the konbini chain heir, huh? I've eaten your family's instant noodles every day for #small_num# years.
Is it true the konbini chain heirs never eat the instant noodles?
Your family's factory smells reach the whole block.
Tell your family the Mystery instant noodles has a tooth in it. Again.
Heir to the instant noodles empire. Do you dream in beige?
My lunch has your family name on it. Literally. It's stamped in.
Does the instant noodles taste better when you own it?
suzunari_pc_class_heir_oxy: Your family's TV jingle wakes me up every morning. Through the wall.
suzunari_pc_class_heir_lumen: the TV news heir. Your family decides what I believe every morning.
Are we on camera right now? With you we're always on camera.
Your family cancelled my favourite show for being 'too true'.
the TV news said it was sunny. Your family lies about the weather.
Can you get me on #media_product#? I can cry on cue.
Are you here to make a documentary about us poor folk?
Say hi to your family's cameras. They're always here anyway.
suzunari_pc_class_old_money: Old money. You can smell it - it smells like real wood.
Nice coat. Real fabric? I could live a month on one sleeve.
People like you don't come down here unless they're buying the street.
Inherited, right? Nobody earns that posture.
Your great-grandparents bought this street, didn't they? Twice.
You've never queued for anything, have you?
suzunari_pc_class_executive: Executive type, huh? Here to 'experience the street'?
Let me guess - you restructured somebody today.
Your shoes cost more than my block.
You've got 'quarterly results' written all over you.
Is this a site visit? Should I look productive?
suzunari_pc_class_gig_worker: Gig worker? Me too. #job.cap# on weekdays, #job# on weekends.
How many apps are you on? I'm on nine.
You look like you're mid-delivery. You're always mid-delivery.
Don't tip, they take it anyway.
Your phone keeps buzzing with offers, doesn't it?
Rate me five stars and I'll rate you five stars.
suzunari_pc_class_working_poor: Working poor, like the rest of us. Welcome to the club. Membership is mandatory.
Three jobs? Four? You look like four.
We're the ones who keep Suzunari running. Nobody says thanks.
Payday's Friday. The money's gone by Thursday.
We should unionise. Quietly. With snacks.
suzunari_pc_class_indebted: You've got the debt look. Eyes that count interest in their sleep.
How deep are you in? Me, I can't see the surface.
the bank's been asking about you. They ask about everyone. But they ask about you more.
Debt's a ghost that follows you, huh?
I know that face. That's a #big_num#-money face.
Got a collector following you? Third crow on the left.
suzunari_pc_class_street_beggar: You've been sleeping rough. I can tell. No judgement - so have I.
The shelter on the corner has heat on Wednesdays.
Here. Half a ration. It's the good half.
Rough out there. Rougher in here. Stay close to the vents.
Corner by the noodle stall is warm. Don't tell the others.
If you need a blanket, the pawn shop throws out the stained ones at #time#.
suzunari_pc_class_collateral: Somebody's paying interest on YOU. Must feel strange.
Owned and still walking around. Respect.
Does your owner know you're in Suzunari?
Owned? Me too, kind of. My landlord thinks so.
suzunari_pc_class_off_grid: The crows look right through you. Teach me.
Off-grid in Suzunari? That's practically a superpower.
I can't even find you on the TV news. Nobody's not on the TV news.
How do you buy anything without a face scan?
The crows went quiet when you walked past. Creepy. Good creepy.
suzunari_pc_age_teen: Aren't you a bit young for Suzunari?
Kids these days. Already in debt. Respect.
Go home, kid. Oh. This is home. Sorry.
{years}? I had three jobs at {years}. Kidding. Four.
Does your mum know you're in Suzunari?
suzunari_pc_age_young: Young and broke. Classic Suzunari combo.
You've still got that hope in your eyes. Give it a month.
You look like you still think things get better.
Enjoy your knees while they're original.
You'll get used to the smog. Or it'll get used to you.
suzunari_pc_age_prime: You look like you've seen a few things.
You've got that 'survived a recession' look.
Not young, not old. Just tired, right?
You've got good years left. Billable years.
Old enough to know better, young enough to do it anyway.
suzunari_pc_age_middle: Middle-aged and still out here. Respect.
Mid-life crisis? Buy a sky-bike. Everyone does.
suzunari_pc_age_elder: Respect, grandparent. You survived this long.
Elders get a discount on Tuesdays. It's 1%.
Still walking at {years}? Teach me your secret. Is it spite?
Respect your elders, they told me. Nobody told the landlord.
suzunari_pc_age_ancient: How old ARE you? You remember the world before the town council?
You've got the eyes of someone who saw real trees.
{years} years old? On Suzunari? That's a miracle or a clerical error.
Tell me about the old world. Was there sky? Real sky?
They should put you in a museum. Respectfully.
You're older than the town council. Does it scare them? It should.
suzunari_pc_bg_cryo_debtor: Woke up in a debt freezer, huh? Welcome to the future. It's worse.
suzunari_pc_bg_asteroid_miner: Did you dig up anything good out there? Besides a cough?
suzunari_pc_bg_street_medic: You've got that medic look. Tired and sticky.
Street medic? My neighbour owes you her life. And #small_num# money.
If I faint, you're catching me. Professional duty.
suzunari_pc_bg_clone_reject: You look like somebody. Somebody expensive.
suzunari_pc_bg_corp_lawyer: Lawyer. I can tell. You're reading the small print on my face.
Company lawyer in Suzunari? Who are you suing?
suzunari_pc_bg_ad_copywriter: You people wrote the jingle that lives in my skull rent-free.
Copywriter. Say something persuasive. ...Wow. I almost bought it.
suzunari_pc_bg_repo_agent: You've got debt eyes. Pricing everything you look at.
Ex-debt? You took my neighbour's door once. Just the door.
suzunari_pc_bg_paste_worker: You smell like the vats. instant noodles worker?
instant noodles under your fingernails. That never washes out, does it?
suzunari_pc_bg_smuggler: Smuggler. You've got that 'pockets inside pockets' coat.
Anything good in the cargo hold? Asking for nobody.
Smugglers keep Suzunari alive. Don't tell #faction#.
suzunari_pc_bg_holo_preacher: You preach on the feeds, right? My nan watches you.
suzunari_pc_bg_union_organiser: Union? Here? Say it louder - they hate that.
Workers of Suzunari, unite... and then what? Tell me the 'then what'.
suzunari_pc_bg_ex_paragon: You stand like a cop. Ex-the police?
Old police habits. You checked the exits when you walked up.
Ex-cop, huh? Did you quit or did they quit you?
suzunari_pc_bg_influencer: Wait - you're on the TV news! #small_num#k followers!
Influencer, right? Is this a stream? Am I content?
Do I look okay? Are we live?
suzunari_pc_bg_gambler: Want to bet on how long this conversation lasts?
I'll bet you #small_num# money you lose that bet.
suzunari_pc_bg_street_chef: You smell like real garlic. Chef?
Street chef! What's the secret to making instant noodles taste like food?
Cook something for me sometime. Something with colour.
suzunari_pc_bg_escaped_convict: That's a penal-colony tattoo. Don't worry, I won't tell.
Escaped, huh? From where? The ice moons? Respect.
Hide your wrists. The police check wrists.
suzunari_pc_bg_courier: Courier legs. You've run every alley in Suzunari.
Got anything for me? A package? A message? A life?
Couriers know every shortcut. Where's the one out of here?
suzunari_pc_pers_coward: You flinch at the crows too. It's okay. We all do.
Nervous type? Smart. Nervous people live longer here.
You keep looking for the exits. Good instinct.
suzunari_pc_pers_hothead: You look like you want to punch a billboard. Do it.
Your jaw's clenched. Mine too. It's Suzunari.
suzunari_pc_pers_cynic: You've got that 'seen it all, hated it all' look.
Let me guess: you don't believe a word the TV news says either.
suzunari_pc_pers_idealist: You still believe things can change, don't you? It's all over your face.
Hope looks good on you. Dangerous, but good.
You're one of those dreamers. Suzunari eats dreamers. Be careful.
suzunari_pc_pers_joker: You've got a laugh in you. I can tell. Let it out, it's free. For now.
Tell me a joke. Please. I need it.
You look like you'd make the crows laugh.
suzunari_pc_goal_pay_debt: You count every money twice. Debt?
Paying something off, aren't you? I know the walk.
suzunari_pc_goal_buy_a_planet: You've got big plans. Town-sized plans.
Someone said you want to buy a whole town. Can I rent a room?
suzunari_pc_goal_protect_family: You've got family somewhere. You keep your hand near your phone, waiting for their call.
Somebody depends on you. I can tell.
suzunari_pc_goal_escape_sprawl: You look at the sky like it's an exit.
suzunari_pc_secret_synth_air_allergy: Your eyes go red near the canisters. Interesting.
suzunari_pc_hurt: You look terrible. Clinic's two streets down. Bring money.
Sit down before you fall down.
You need a first-aid kit, friend. Or a priest.
That's a lot of red for one person.
Lean on me. Not too hard, I'm rented.
There's a bandage in the vending machine. #small_num# money.
suzunari_pc_wanted: There's a trouble on you. {trouble} money. That's more than my building.
The police's been asking about you all week.
If they ask, I was never here. If they pay, I was totally here.
Your face is on the posters. You look shorter in person.
{trouble} money on your head. Tempting. Kidding. Mostly.
I'd turn you in, but I hate the police more.
suzunari_pc_famous: Can I get a selfie? I'll pay. Three money?
You're famous! Fame {fame}, the TV news says.
My cousin's a big fan. Also a big the police informant.
Is it true what the TV news says about you?
My kid has your poster. A bootleg one. Sorry.
You were on #media_product#! Or someone who looks like you.
suzunari_pc_flush: You're carrying {money} money? Put that away before someone sees.
You've got money. I can hear it jingle.
Rich today, huh? Buy something for the street.
With that many money you could buy this whole corner.
Careful flashing that. Pickpockets in Suzunari have pickpockets.
That's a lot of money for one coat pocket.
suzunari_pc_broke: Broke? Me too. Let's be broke together.
Empty pockets. I know that sound. That's no sound.
No money? The noodle stand gives leftovers after midnight.
Want some advice? It's free. It's the only free thing here.
Broke is just rich without the money.
suzunari_pc_debt: I can hear your debt growing from here.
suzunari_pc_crew: You travel with {crew}, right? Good people. Weird, but good.
Heard {crew} is on your ship. Tell them hi.
A crew, huh? On Asagiri-do? That ship's a legend. A bad legend.
Your crew looks out for you. Hold on to that.
suzunari_pc_upgraded: You've had work done. Good work. Expensive work.
suzunari_pc_killer: People die around you. I've noticed.
They say you've got a body count. They say a lot of things.
Stay back. I heard what you did.
Murderer. That's what they call you in Suzunari.
suzunari_pc_saint: You're the one who helps people. Everybody's talking.
You give money away. Are you okay? Medically?
Kindness is rare here. People notice.
suzunari_pc_planet: {controller} runs Suzunari. Runs it into the ground.
This {crisis} is killing us. Slowly. With fees.
Over on {other_planet} they've got {other_crisis}. At least ours is familiar.
{local_name} is the only one fighting for Suzunari.
{controller} put a tax on queuing. I'm queuing to complain.
Suzunari used to be nice. Before {controller}. Before me.
They say {crisis} will be over by spring. They said that last spring.
suzunari_pc_saga: They say {antagonist} wants to {scheme}. the TV news calls it 'a bold vision'.
Heard {ally} is looking for someone like you.
Everyone's talking about {macguffin}. Nobody knows what it is.
{antagonist}. The {antagonist_title}. Don't say the name too loud.
{lieutenant} came through here last week. Smiling. Never a good sign.
If you're headed to {objective_planet}, bring a coat. And a lawyer.
{ally} said someone like you would come through. I thought they were drunk.
People whisper about {macguffin} like it's a ghost story.
suzunari_npc_life: My #kin# just started as #job.a#. So proud. So poor.
I've got #pet_desc# #pet_kind# called #pet_name#. Best thing in my life.
I'm saving up for #aspiration#. #small_num# more years.
My #kin# wants to be #dream.a# when they grow up.
Today's my day off. I'm spending it standing here. It's free.
I'm {job_a}. It's a job. That's the best thing I can say about it.
You know what I need? {need}. Same as everyone.
suzunari_worry: what's really in the instant noodles
suzunari_now_charity: Somebody just helped somebody. Call the TV news.
Was that charity? Is that still legal?
Money for nothing? Who ARE you?
Look at that. Kindness. In public.
suzunari_now_threat: That's no way to talk to {target}.
suzunari_now_kill_cop: The police's going to burn the block for this.
Did you just... in front of everyone?
suzunari_now_kill_repo: the bank's gonna bill somebody for that.
suzunari_now_deal: I didn't see that. Unless I get a cut.
suzunari_now_hurt: Somebody get them a first-aid kit!
suzunari_judge_disapprove: That's not how we do things here.
#faction# would be proud. That's not a compliment.
suzunari_judge_amused: Best thing I've seen all week.
I'd pay to see that again.
suzunari_act_charity: helped {target} out when nobody else would
suzunari_act_kill_cop: took down a cop in the street
put {target} down. A cop. In the street
suzunari_act_kill_repo: scrapped a the bank debt unit
turned a debt collectors into spare parts
put a debt collector out of business
suzunari_act_skill: dodged {target} like it owed you money
moved like a billboard on fast-forward
pulled a move I've only seen on #media_product#
danced around {target} like it was nothing
suzunari_gossip_open: They're saying in the queue that you
suzunari_rep_open: The street's favourite story is how you
If you ask the queue at the noodle stall: you
the TV news hasn't caught on, but the street knows you
suzunari_rep_nothing: People? About you? Nothing. You're nobody yet. Enjoy it.
Never heard of you. That's a compliment in Suzunari.
Nobody's said a word. Either you're careful or you're boring.
suzunari_after_charity_ok: I'm going to tell everyone about you.
Nobody's done that for me in years.
I'll pay it forward. Probably. Eventually.
You're not like the others in Suzunari.
suzunari_after_show_ok: Do it again! Do it again!
You should have a show on the TV news.
Best thing I've seen in Suzunari all week.
suzunari_after_beg_ok: Here. Don't tell anyone I'm soft.
Times are hard. I get it.
Don't spend it on instant noodles.
suzunari_merchant_ask: Buying, selling, or wasting my billable time?
Take a look. Touching is extra.
Today only: prices. Tomorrow: higher prices.
Got something to sell? I've got something to sell you back.
suzunari_grudge_call: The police? Yes. I'd like to report a person.
Hello, complaints? You're going to love this one.
I'm calling it in. Don't try to stop me.
The police? I have a name and a face for you.
suzunari_furious_bark: You've got some nerve showing your face.
Everyone - that's the one I told you about!
I'm still not over what you did.
The police have your description, you know.
suzunari_robbed_notice: Someone took my money! SOMEONE TOOK MY YEN!
No no no - my ration card! Gone!
I've been robbed! On #day#! Who robs on #day#?
My pocket's lighter. Why is my pocket lighter?
suzunari_heckle_bark: Oh look, it's the one who flopped earlier!
Hey! Do the thing again! The bad thing!
I've seen better from a vending machine.
suzunari_intrigued_bark: So where are you from? Really from?
Is it true what they say about you?
Why Suzunari? Nobody comes to Suzunari.
suzunari_intrigued_bye: Okay, I've got to go. But listen - one thing.
Thanks for not being boring. Here's something for you.
You're the most interesting thing in Suzunari. Take this tip.
suzunari_keeper_greet_warm: Look who's back! Best customer in Suzunari.
Come in, come in! Mind the puddle.
suzunari_pc_new: You're the Asagiri grandson, aren't you? You have his eyebrows.
The transfer student! Tokyo, right? Bet it doesn't rain like this there.
You're the one that first-year follows around.
Your grandpa used to give us free sweets. Just saying.
New kid. You'll get used to the cats. They won't get used to you.
Second-year, class B? Makabe-sensei's class. He's nice. Sad, but nice.
suzunari_ad_body: Suzunari Line: next train in 40 min
